3. **Number of manual cars**: 186

\[
\text{Number of semi-automatic cars} = \text{Total cars} - (\text{Automatic cars} + \text{Manual cars}) = 600 - (12 + 186) = 600 - 198 = 402
\]

Next, calculate the percentage of semi-automatic cars:
\[
\text{Percentage of semi-automatic cars} = \left(\frac{\text{Number of semi-automatic cars}}{\text{Total cars}}\right) \times 100\% = \left(\frac{402}{600}\right) \times 100\% = 67\%
\]
